data.long_meaning: The name 'Alhah' is the Arabic name for God, and it signifies the belief in the oneness of God. This name is considered the most sacred and revered name in Islam, and it is often used as a reminder of the divine presence and guidance. The name Alhah carries the meaning “The One and Only God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alhah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one and only god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
